status: Local candidate evidence for the subsequently published and deployed experimental SDK/runtime 0.12.0.
change: Deliver descriptor-based shebang execution through the ordinary Worker and native service binding. SDK action inference uses the concrete native Action input type so source and emitted declarations retain portable action/response relationships without casts. Shared descriptor cases verify normal execution, rename, unlink, CLOEXEC and explicit-close failure, and per-case retained file effects.

verification.typecheck: Source and compiled SDK clients pass the shared proof contracts. A native generic Action input and its indexed discriminator replace an intersection that emitted incompatible client method declarations.

exactArchives.transport: native Alchemy workerd service binding and Agent RPC; local R2 and Queue
exactArchives.proof: SDK archive exports and consumer declarations; runtime archive; filesystem snapshot restore; hard-link metadata; RPC callbacks and cooperative disposal; persistent driver contexts and cancellation; scoped authority

minuteiCompatibility.transport: native workerd Agent service binding; actual Minutei Code Mode and tenant SQLite; local R2, KV and Queue

verification.plan: Alchemy minutei/prod: update the existing Sandbox Worker and run unconditional Migrations; R2, Queue, consumer and bindings remain noop.
verification.cleanInstall: Exact SDK archive installed through Bun with scripts disabled, Effect 4.0.4 and TanStack Code Mode 0.5.2; public root/RPC/contracts imports passed.

orderedBatchAcknowledgements.contract: All five fixture uploads must acknowledge the expected ordered paths before the binding proof runs.
